primary_candidate.model: CpG-specific de novo methylation probabilities and fetal-ground-state beta values fitted in healthy blood; assumes largely tissue-independent parameters. Cumulative TNSC can be estimated without age, but R=TNSC/age cannot.
primary_candidate.assay_gate: Built on450K probes; exact common-probe coverage in these processed450K/EPIC matrices, fitted coefficients and normalization transport not evaluated. No score calculated.
primary_candidate.validation: Normal adult tissue and listed TCGA cancers, not EMC or sarcoma in this primary validation. This is not proof of inability to apply in sarcoma.
limits: Cumulative average over cell histories is not current proliferation or clinical aggressiveness.
Individual ages absent in10 referenceEMC and62 fixed controls, preventing rate or age-adjusted contrast.
Tumor-mixture, fetal baseline and methylation-transmission assumptions remain material.

contrary_or_improved_method.method: stemTOC371CpGs selected using fibroblast/endothelial/smooth-muscle cell-line population doublings with cell-cycle inhibition; fetal ground-state and immune-fraction adjustments.
contrary_or_improved_method.useful_contrary_evidence: Shows mesenchymal-cell methodological plausibility and reduction of non-mitotic chronological-age confounding, so generic claims that all clocks are age-only or intrinsically unusable in sarcoma would be wrong.
contrary_or_improved_method.unresolved: Authors explicitly retain weighted bulk-cell/history confounding;15 cancer-type validation does not include authenticated EMC. Switching clocks after this failed prespecified interpretation is not allowed as a rescue.
contrary_or_improved_method.quote: Even if the CpGs making up the counter are not cell-type specific, it is clear that different cell types in a bulk-sample may have different mitotic ages, hence the mitotic age estimate reflects a weighted average over the mitotic ages of each cell type with the weights reflecting their cell-type proportions.

scientific_value: A new numerical descriptor could be computed with sufficient inputs, but without interpretable replication or orthogonal/clinical link it would not yet change an EMC researcher's next measurement beyond established diagnostic epigenetic classes. No causal age/proliferation, lineage, or treatment inference is justified.
